newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Tourvest buys tour operator for 9.5mln rand.
newsitem.headline: Tourvest buys tour operator for 9.5mln rand.

text.p: Tourism Investment Corp Ltd said on Tuesday it had acquired, with effect from October 1 1996, the business of inbound tour operator Holiday Africa for 9.5 million rand.
It would pay for the acquisition by a cash payment of 1.2 million rand and the issue of 5.93 million Tourvest shares at 140 cents each.
It said the acquisition would increase Tourvest's forecast earnings per share of 4.0 cents for the year to June 30 to 4.4 cents, but would have no significant effect on its net asset value per share.
